doubts.claim_under_doubt: Open-file tabs in MissionInfoSidebar are per-task.
doubts.disproof_attempt: The task route element is not keyed by taskId, so task-to-task navigation without unmount could carry tabs over (an outside file tab would then send the wrong task id). Not confirmed that any in-app link does this.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Key the sidebar by task.taskId or clear tabs on change, or rebut.

doubts.disproof_attempt: Embedded viewer body renders only while visible so tab switches remount SmartViewer, refetch and lose scroll position.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: State intent or hide via CSS.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: The tablist is exposed to assistive tech.
doubts.disproof_attempt: role=tablist on a display:contents element is dropped in older WebKit.
